definitions.gloss: masterminding; plotting; being the ringleader of a plan or scheme
definitions.explanation: The act of planning and leading a plot, conspiracy, or organized action. Almost always carries a negative connotation, implying criminal activity, rebellion, or wrongdoing.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: The mastermind of the incident was arrested.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}がクーデターを{首謀|しゅぼう}したと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: He is said to have masterminded the coup.

examples.japanese: {詐欺|さぎ}グループの{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}は{長年|ながねん}にわたって{捜査|そうさ}の{手|て}を{逃|のが}れていた。
examples.english: The ringleader of the fraud group had evaded investigation for many years.

notes:
Composed of {首|しゅ} (head, chief) + {謀|ぼう} (plot, scheme). Most commonly encountered in the compound {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ} (mastermind, ringleader). The word is strongly negative, associated with criminal plots, conspiracies, rebellions, and organized wrongdoing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}: mastermind, ringleader
- {首謀|しゅぼう}する: to mastermind, to plot
- {事件|じけん}の{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}: the mastermind behind the incident
- テロの{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}: the mastermind of the terrorist attack

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {黒幕|くろまく}: mastermind behind the scenes — implies pulling strings from a hidden position
- {主犯|しゅはん}: principal offender — the legal term for the main perpetrator
- {張本人|ちょうほんにん}: the person responsible — the one who is the root cause of trouble
